channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Roughly 150 Smithfield High students walk out in anti-ICE protest
item.description: Roughly 150 Smithfield High School students participated in an anti-ICE walkout on Feb. 27, the latest of several student-led protests across the state and nation.

item.title: School Board adopts plan to address Hardy Elementary ‘off track’ rating
item.description: Isle of Wight’s School Board approved a three-year plan for Hardy Elementary after a federal finding resulted in an “off track" rating under Virginia's new school evaluation system.

item.title: IW supervisors vote to keep 2026 car tax rate unchanged
item.description: Isle of Wight is keeping its 2026 car tax at $4.50 per $100.

item.title: Letter – Supervisors betray Carrollton
item.description: Letter: Carrollton’s Aurora Lambright denounces Isle of Wight supervisors’ 3-2 approval of 35 condos on Cedar Grove Road, warning of traffic and lost natural beauty.

item.title: Letter – IW must support 2nd Amendment
item.description: Letter: Isle of Wight resident Heidi Swartz presses the Board to shift its constitutional county resolution to a symbolic Second Amendment sanctuary stance backing the right to keep and bear arms.

item.title: Letter – ‘Affordability’ is quite costly
item.description: Letter: Carrsville resident Volpe Boykin argues Virginia Democrats’ ‘affordability’ agenda raises taxes, boosts costs for services, and restricts gun rights while using new revenue to fund social programs.

item.title: Smithfield-IW Tourism presents five-year plan to Town Council
item.description: Smithfield and Isle of Wight's shared tourism department unveiled a 5-year plan, which Smithfield's Town Council is scheduled to adopt on March 3.

item.title: Keeping Your Yard and Living Spaces Clean Year-Round
item.description: Maintaining an attractive outdoor space requires more than seasonal mowing and watering.

item.title: Off-Road Vehicle Upgrades and Garage Maintenance Essentials
item.description: Off-road vehicles are built to handle terrain that standard passenger cars are not designed to endure.

item.title: Finding freedom: Isaac Holleman escaped slavery in IW during the Civil War. His descendants are now telling his story.
item.description: Holleman descendants, both Black and white, are working together to tell the story of Isaac, a man born into slavery in Isle of Wight County who escaped to freedom during the Civil War.
